title: Concurrent Man-in-the-Middle Authentication from Weak PRFs
summary: The paper achieves sequential man-in-the-middle security, but efficient authentication from generic weak PRFs with concurrent man-in-the-middle security remains open.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved task is to construct an efficient authentication scheme from generic weak-PRFs that is secure in the concurrent man-in-the-middle model.

scope.domain: Authentication schemes from generic weak PRFs under man-in-the-middle security.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an efficient authentication scheme from generic weak PRFs that is secure in the concurrent man-in-the-middle model.

citations.label: Man-in-the-Middle Secure Authentication Schemes from LPN and Weak PRFs

progress.summary: The paper proves only sequential man-in-the-middle security and explicitly presents efficient concurrent security from generic weak PRFs as an interesting open problem.
citation_labels: Vadim Lyubashevsky et al., Man-in-the-Middle Secure Authentication Schemes from LPN and Weak PRFs
